title: SEC1: RUNBOOK omits cert expiry failure mode and its log signature
description: RUNBOOK.md (line 150) mentions that a restart is required after cert renewal but does not describe what operators will see when a cert has expired and the server has not been restarted. The failure mode is: TLS handshake errors with alert certificate_expired on the client side; on the server side the log shows 'TLS handshake failed: ...' (warn level) per connection with no distinction between an expired-cert rejection and a config error. An operator seeing a stream of TLS handshake failures needs to know to check cert expiry first. The runbook should document the expected log message for an expired cert rejection and suggest checking with openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -dates.
